summary: Man became unresponsive and hypothermic after going into icy Barker Reservoir to retrieve two dogs; a Nederland PD detective revived him, NFPD treated him on scene, and AMR transported him to Boulder Community Hospital.
location: Barker Reservoir shoreline near water treatment ponds, Nederland
responding_agency: Nederland Police Department; Nederland Fire Protection District; American Medical Response
notes: Incident occurred the day after Thanksgiving 2016 (story date arithmetic). Dogs entered icy water; owner collapsed at shore's edge with hypothermia after his dog got stuck under an ice ledge. Fire/EMS response; no SAR team paged.
